name: Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - MARCH 25, 2004 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
Consent Calendar
7.
Registers of Demands dated 3/25/2004
8.
Minutes of 3/11/2004, 3/16/2004 and 3/18/2004
9.
Miscellaneous
9A.
Award of Bid No. 971-04, printing of the 2004/2005 Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts Season Brochure
9B.
Confirmation of a finding by the City Council of the City of Cerritos that an emergency situation currently exists warranting the immediate replacement of the City Hall computer room HVAC system and a determination by the Council of the need to continue the action
10.
Pending Legal Matters
10.A.
Ordinances adopting amendments to the Redevelopment Plan for the Los Cerritos Redevelopment Project and Los Coyotes Redevelopment Project pursuant to Senate Bill 1045 as codified in Health and Safety Code Section 33333.6(e)(2)
10.B.
A resolution approving the third amended and restated Joint Exercise of Powers Agreement
10.C.
A resolution supporting a statewide ballot initiative to require voter approval before State Government may take local tax funds
10D.
Ordinance amending Title 2 of the Cerritos Municipal Code to establish an Economic Development Commission and a resolution providing for the organization, membership and duties of the Economic Development Commission
11.
Public Works Activities
11A.
Authorization to join in amicus brief with the California Building Industry Association in connection with that action entitled City of Burbank, et al. v. State Water Resources Control Board, et al. pending before the California Supreme Court
11B.
Award of a contract for the construction of the Los Cerritos Community Safety Center, Bid No. 970-04, Project No. 19009
12.
New and Old Business
12.A.
Selection of the Olson Company as the preferred developer and authorization for execution of an Exclusive Negotiation Agreement (ENA) with the preferred developer for the construction of an 18-unit affordable senior housing project to be located at the southeast corner of 183rd Street and Carmenita Road within the Los Coyotes Redevelopment Project Area (APN 7023-007-025, APN 7023-007-901 & APN 7023-007-902)
13.
Appointment of an Alternate Member to the County Sanitation Districts 2, 3, 18 and 19
14.
Report on pending legislation
15.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports
16.
Adjournment
